Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk

Class JpaResourceBulkEngine<ID,F>

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk.JpaResourceBulkEngine<ID,F>
public final class JpaResourceBulkEngine<ID,F> extends Object
Declarative resource adapter over the existing protected proposal and durable execution kernel. Construction performs no I/O, DDL, publication or worker startup. Policy remains host-owned.
